scope.objective: Add a request timeout flag to the sync CLI without changing library defaults.

generated_or_external: distribution artifacts under dist/ are generated

subsystems.purpose: Parse user options and construct one client invocation.
state_and_data: parsed timeout value for one process invocation

subsystems.purpose: Execute synchronization requests through the configured transport.

steps: Client passes timeout to transport call
state_and_side_effects: One outbound request may be cancelled at the configured deadline
failure_paths: Non-positive values fail before client construction
Transport timeout keeps the existing timeout error mapping

risk_surface.condition: CLI implementation changes the library default instead of passing an explicit value.
risk_surface.consequence: Existing library consumers observe a behavioural change.

knowledge.statement: The CLI is the natural owner of the new flag and validation.
knowledge.impact_if_wrong: The library public API could change unnecessarily.

knowledge.statement: The installed console entry point behaves the same on every supported platform.
knowledge.impact_if_wrong: Release support claims would be too broad.
knowledge.next_check: Run installed-artifact smoke tests in the supported platform matrix.

sufficiency.reason: The owner, call path, protected default, direct files, and focused proof are identified.
remaining_material_unknowns: Cross-platform installed-artifact verification remains a release concern, not an implementation blocker.
